scope: Selected variants only; no whole-suite coverage claim. Each supported variant runs in an isolated native process. Synchronous and Promise-job asynchronous Scripts use parsed strictness and unchanged harness sources. Parse/early-negative tests use native syntax validation without evaluation. Unsupported module execution, agents, lowering and runtime operations, as well as harness errors, crashes and timeouts remain in the totals. Module and Script-root dynamic imports use the captured runtime, checked referrer views and lazy sibling table loader. Literal absent siblings and empty specifiers reject with TypeError; other undiscovered specifiers remain unsupported. Native fixture syntax checks remain lazy at load. JSON, attributes beyond option validation, top-level await and proposal phases remain unsupported.
variantPolicy: All syntaxVariants from tools/test262.ts; raw/strict/sloppy/module flags retained; fixture files excluded. No unsupported or failed variants excluded from the denominator.

compilation.failurePolicy: A failed batch compilation is retained for every affected variant; no automatic retry.
